Traced the full casing chain and verified completeness for both feature-touched functions. CRITICAL CASING TRACE (sound): register (useSession.ts:39) and magicLink (useSession.ts:91) both call apiPost WITHOUT skipKeysToSnake (only login at line 8 passes skipKeysToSnake:true). apiPost (api.ts:25) delegates to apiMutate (api.ts:40) with skipKeysToSnake defaulting false, so line 52 sends allKeysToSnake(variables). allKeysToSnake (structure.js:94) applies lodash snakeCase to every key: utmSource->utm_source, utmCampaign->utm_campaign, utmData->utm_data, internalRef->internal_ref. These four wire keys exactly match the backend permit at registrations_controller.rb:310 (:utm_source, :utm_campaign, :internal_ref, utm_data: {}) consumed as sign_up_params by both create (/sign_up) and magic_create (/magic_login). NO casing mismatch; no silent non-persistence. Convention proof: the pre-existing camelCase multi-word param loginIntent (magicLink) relies on the identical allKeysToSnake path to become login_intent, which is permitted at line 310 -- confirms the same convention the new fields depend on already works in production.

COMPLETENESS: register -- all four fields present in BOTH the destructuring (lines 34-37) AND the variables body (lines 47-50), keys character-identical, no typo, no dropped key. magicLink -- all four present in the destructuring (lines 65-68), the inline TS type (lines 78-81), AND the variables body (lines 103-106); character-identical, no typo. Diff (62dd55867..fc3f047f9) confirms these are the only changes: purely additive, no existing param removed or reordered.

TS TYPES (sound): magicLink type declares utmSource?/utmCampaign?/internalRef? as string|null and utmData? as Record<string,any>|null (lines 78-81), consistent with the pre-existing referral?/partner? string|null optionals. register remains untyped (implicit any) -- pre-existing file convention (login, sendPasswordResetEmail, resetPassword, register are all untyped; only magicLink carries a type); the feature preserved that convention, not a defect.

UNDEFINED vs NULL threading (sound): sanitizer yields undefined for absent params; undefined values pass through allKeysToSnake unchanged (structure.js:104 returns undefined for non-object/non-array) and JSON.stringify (axios) drops undefined keys, so the wire param never arrives and the column stays nil -- matches SPEC absence semantics (SPEC.md:177). A valueless ?utm_source parses to null, survives snake-casing and JSON serialization as null, and Rails reads it as nil -- also matches SPEC:177.

Nested utmData key snake-casing: allKeysToSnake recurses into utmData's inner object (structure.js:104), lodash-snake-casing each inner key (e.g. utm_content2 -> utm_content_2). This is NOT a defect -- it is explicitly documented and accepted in SPEC.md:158 and SPEC.md:321 (Risk 3, 'API-layer key normalization'), with canonical utm_* names unaffected. Not flagged.
